$description: Semantic tokens. These are the ONLY tokens components may reference. Each leaf carries one value per mode; the build emits a :root block plus per-mode override blocks. A `{...}` value is a reference into primitives.json.

canvas.$description: The application ground. Everything else sits on this.

surface.$description: Default panel/card surface — documents, sidebars, dialogs.

surface-raised.$description: Surfaces that float above `surface`: menus, popovers, the command palette.

surface-sunken.$description: Recessed wells: input fields, the Calc grid gutter, code blocks.

scrim.$description: Behind modals. Not a material — no blur, just a dimming layer.

material-thin.$description: Translucent chrome (toolbars, tab strips). Pairs with --nova-blur-thin. High-contrast modes drop translucency entirely — see docs/design-system.md#materials.

tertiary.$description: Metadata, placeholder text, inactive tab labels. This is still text, so it holds 4.5:1 on every surface it is allowed on — it is NOT a licence to go light. gray.500 was too faint in light mode (3.6:1) and was darkened to gray.600.

disabled.$description: Exempt from contrast minimums per WCAG 2.2 (inactive controls), but kept legible on purpose.

on-accent.$description: Label colour on a filled accent surface. Light modes fill dark and label white; dark modes fill BRIGHT and label near-black. That inversion is forced, not stylistic: on a dark ground the fill must clear 3:1 against the surface while the label clears 4.5:1 against the fill, and no single indigo step satisfies both with a white label.

border.$description: Two families here, and the distinction is a WCAG one. `subtle` and `default` are DECORATIVE separators — they group and align, and removing them loses no information, so SC 1.4.11 does not apply. `control` and `strong` are the visible boundary of an interactive control; they carry meaning and must hold 3:1 against their surface. Never use `default` as a control boundary.

subtle.$description: Decorative hairlines: list rows, toolbar groups, table rules.

default.$description: Decorative. Panel edges, card outlines, section dividers.

control.$description: The boundary of an interactive control — text inputs, selects, secondary buttons, checkboxes. Meaningful, so ≥3:1 against surface and canvas in every mode.

strong.$description: Emphasised or selected control boundary. Also ≥3:1.

focus.$description: The focus ring. Deliberately high-chroma so it never reads as a border.

accent.$description: Filled accent surfaces. The ramp runs DARKER on hover/press in light modes and BRIGHTER in dark modes — in both cases the interaction moves away from the surface, and the label token (text.on-accent) inverts to match.

elevation.$description: Elevation pairs a shadow with an implied surface. Dark modes lean on lighter surfaces rather than deeper shadows, because shadow is nearly invisible on a dark ground.

floating.$description: Popovers, dropdowns, the floating Writer toolbar.
